lines.text: Hushai the Archite greets Absalom as king and promises to serve him as he served David.
Ahithophel advises Absalom to sleep with his father's concubines, and Absalom does so on a tent on the roof.
Ahithophel proposes choosing twelve thousand men to pursue David that night and strike down only the priest.
Hushai advises gathering all Israel from Dan to Beersheba, led by Joab, and Absalom prefers his advice.

wrong_details.true: Absalom himself leads them into battle

lines.text: Jonathan and Ahimaaz hide in a well at Bahurim, warn David, and Ahithophel hangs himself after his advice is rejected.
